verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and metering platform, not an automation engine, but it does ship background behaviors you configure once. Subscription schedules move between phases automatically at set times (autumn-docs-23). Usage alerts fire at defined thresholds (autumn-docs-9). Webhooks fire on plan changes and are documented for triggering external workflows (autumn-docs-8, autumn-docs-19). Token usage is tracked automatically for AI SDK calls (autumn-docs-18). Any general-purpose autonomous automation has to be built by the user in external systems fed by these webhooks. Missing for 10: a native, user-defined automation or workflow builder; agent-driven background tasks; independent or hands-on corroboration that these mechanisms work autonomously.
